subject.title: fix(doctor): merge legacy flat auth repair into existing SQLite store

question: Should the legacy-flat doctor repair preserve existing SQLite auth profiles over imported flat JSON profiles and leave the flat JSON in place when SQLite verification fails?
rationale: This is persisted credential migration behavior: automation can verify the code path, but maintainers need to own the upgrade and auth/security boundary decision before merge.

options.title: Accept existing SQLite wins
options.body: Land this PR after required checks, with focused rebase/testing if related auth migration work lands first.

options.title: Add shipped-shape fixture first
options.body: Require one more regression fixture from an observed shipped flat auth-profiles.json shape before merge.

options.title: Pause for broader migration direction
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide how it should sequence with startup/update stranded-JSON work.

recommendation.title: Accept existing SQLite wins
recommendation.body: Land this PR after required checks, with focused rebase/testing if related auth migration work lands first.

likelyOwner.reason: The SQLite auth-store refactor and earlier flat doctor migration history make this the strongest available owner signal for the upgrade boundary decision.
